title: A version of the resume for a particular posting
description: The requirements are set against real experience, while the main profile stays as it is.

blocks.text: In a long history it is hard to pick out what fits one application. Matching words don’t yet mean the experience is there.

quote.text: Great for creating a CV but would be better if you could save within the app and personalise for each job application

blocks.text: Show how a requirement connects to confirmed work or a confirmed skill. Let the order and the level of detail of a separate resume version be chosen.
Don’t write in skills that are missing for the sake of a match. A requirement that isn’t covered is something for the author to decide about, not a field to be filled in automatically.
